title: Integral scalar extension preserves bounded constructible integral complexes
statement: Let $E\subset L$ be finite extensions of $\Ql$ with valuation rings $\mathcal O_E\subset\mathcal O_L$, with $\ell\neq p$, and let $Y$ be a scheme. For every $K\in D^b_c(Y,\mathcal O_E)$ [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], the integral scalar extension $K\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}\mathcal O_L$ [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension] lies in $D^b_c(Y,\mathcal O_L)$. Hence integral scalar extension restricts to an $\mathcal O_E$-linear functor $D^b_c(Y,\mathcal O_E)\to D^b_c(Y,\mathcal O_L)$.

source.place: last paragraph (the functor $-\otimes_EL:D^b_c(Y,E)\to D^b_c(Y,L)$ is defined on integral representatives, which presupposes this); also asserted in dag node lem-coef-integral-finite-extension ('This exact functor preserves the integral bounded constructible categories')
